name: BSB Bank
note: Official partner of HC Dinamo Minsk; the BSB Bank logo is on the front hem of the 2026-27 home jersey (official KHL kit render and club press photos). Belarusian commercial bank founded 2002 with 100% foreign capital: shareholders are three Swiss companies (Swiss Investment Century, Alpin Professional Investment, Profinvest Professional and Financial Investment), per the cbonds.ru issuer profile; ultimate owners not traced (the bank's own ownership page at bsb.by does not render server-side).
